name: The Brokild Collection (all seven)
description: Every Brokild plugin in one download: six instruments and one effect for Windows, with their manuals and their standalones. Photo-Synth 2, Escape Room, Blade Ruiner, Black Rider, Clone Wars, Full Metal Racket and Martian Gain. They were built one at a time, each to answer a different question, but they share a rack of global effects that runs inside all of them, one patch folder, and a way of working: nothing is asserted, every claim is measured by a bench that renders real audio and reads the numbers off it.
note: Windows VST3 · 61 MB · six instruments and one effect · all manuals included.
